home.intro: I build backend and data systems, and lately AI agents: the tools, tracing and billing behind an in-product agent. This site is also a public MCP server, so you can ask an AI assistant about my work. On the blog I write up what I build and learn.

mcp.title: Chat with me via MCP
mcp.intro: Connect an AI assistant to this site and ask it about my experience, skills, projects and writing.
prompts: Give me a short overview of Edmar and his strongest skills.
Which tech stack his projects uses?
mcp.claudeApp: Open claude.ai/customize/connectors, add a custom connector and paste the server URL. On Team and Enterprise plans an admin has to add it.
mcp.chatgpt: Add a custom MCP server in ChatGPT and paste the server URL. Choose no authentication if asked. Menu names, plan availability and workspace policies change often, so an admin may need to allow it.
mcp.other: Any client that supports remote MCP over streamable HTTP can use the same URL.
